messages:
Sasha: handing off to @Devon in ~10m (18:00 PT). Quick notes: PR #489 (prefetch tweak) rolled at 12:05 — expect a small bump in cold-starts for the embed worker. p95 for embed has risen ~10% since ~12:15 but no error rate increase. I also changed dedicated autoscale min from 2 -> 1 for the night experiment (cluster rdw-dedicated-eu). Watch for flaps. Rollout: <https://ci.redwood/rollouts/489>

Devon: ack — thanks. I'll take the pager at 18:00 PT. Can you paste the exact kubectl command you used for the min change and the cooldown tweak?

Sasha: sure — used the patch below and bumped the HPA cooldown to 90s in ops-config:

```
kubectl -n inference patch hpa embed-worker --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":1}]'
# ops-config: embed-hpa.cooldown = 90s
```

deploy-bot: deploy finished: PR 489 -> prod at 2024-09-14T12:05Z

ops-bot: alerting: embed-p95 up 9% (since 12:20). No error increase. Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood/embed

Priya: fyi — I left a rollback script here: `./scripts/rollback-prefetch.sh`. If queue backs up or retries spike, run that and ping infra. Also I'll run the perf job tomorrow morning to validate the change.

Sasha: action items for the night:
- Devon: monitor embed-p95 and queue depth for the next 2 hours; if p95 > 1.2x baseline or queue > 30k, start trace and escalate.
- If autoscaler flaps >3 times in 30m, set minReplicas back to 2 and notify @infra.
- Priya: run perf job & follow up on any regressions tomorrow.

Devon: got it. I'll also enable a short tracing session if p95 crosses the threshold. I'll log updates to the oncall doc and ping here for anything urgent.

Priya: thanks — I should be reachable if you need a quick revert. :thumbsup:

Sasha: leaving pager to Devon now. bridge is up (link: https://meet.redwood/ops-bridge-241820). Good luck.

Devon: taking over. start 18:00 PT. I'll post a brief check-in at 19:00 PT or sooner if anything spikes.

ops-bot: note: maintenance window for storage cleanup starts 02:00 PT; not related but FYI if extra load appears.
